decisions.reason: This position covers temporary site setup, operation, protection, logistics, and clearance, not the purchase of new equipment or materials.
The deliverable is a piping and instrumentation diagram, not the equipment shown on it.
The deliverable is an overview diagram. The mounting board or frame is part of its presentation, not a separately ordered product.
The position covers drawings, schedules, and supporting site measurements, not the supply of the components depicted.
The position requires technical documentation, functional specifications, and coordination. The electrical switchgear is tendered separately.
The position covers as-built documentation, operating instructions, and a staff briefing. The binders and digital media are delivery formats.
The position requires new physical identification signs, including holders, to be supplied and installed.

items.material_name: Plastic plant component identification sign with slide-in label and holder, minimum 10 x 5 cm, minimum 7 mm lettering
items.description: DIN EN ISO 10628 identifiers, black lettering on white, clear cover; UV-, temperature-, chemical-, and scratch-resistant.
